calls.title: Reconnect
calls.summary: The discussion centered on evaluating two EOR service pricing offers from Deal and Rippling. Deal presented competitive tiered pricing, offering a one-year rate of $179 per month and a two-year rate at $460 per month, both with significant loyalty credits. Concerns were raised by Jennifer regarding employee retention and the uncertainties of committing to a longer contract. The discussion also highlighted contract flexibility, with options to reallocate unused funds. Urgency was placed on timely onboarding, aiming for a March 30th target and requiring a decision by March 25th. Litigation concerns involving Deal were addressed, emphasizing the need for reassurance from leadership. Allison was tasked with escalating these concerns to ensure client trust. A follow-up meeting was scheduled to address outstanding questions and facilitate the final decision.
calls.keywords: EOR fees, Contract terms, Loyalty credit, Litigation concerns, Early invoicing, Onboarding timeline
calls.action_items:
